newsitem.title: USA: Anadigics sees Q3 results below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Anadigics sees Q3 results below estimates.

text.p: Anadigics Inc said Friday it expects its third quarter net income and net sales will fall below Wall Street analysts' estimates.
The company said it expects third quarter net income to be "substantially" below its second quarter net income of $2.1 million or $0.24 per share.
Third quarter net sales are expected to surpass second quarter revenues of $15.9 million, but will fall short of Wall Street expectations, the company said.
